metadata.topic: Reactivity Series — Balanced Equation: Calcium + Dilute Hydrochloric Acid
metadata.note: 3m: write balanced symbol equation for metal X (calcium) reacting with dilute HCl. Ca(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂(g). Marks: 1m correct formulae; 1m balanced (1:2:1:1 ratio); 1m correct state symbols. Context: reactivity series experiment where different metals are added to acid to observe rate of reaction.

question.name: CSEC Chem Jan 2024 Q2b(iv) — Balanced Equation: Calcium + Dilute HCl
question.text:
In an experiment, metal X (calcium) was added to dilute hydrochloric acid and bubbles were observed.

Write a balanced symbol equation, including state symbols, for the reaction of calcium with dilute hydrochloric acid. (3 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Calcium + dilute hydrochloric acid:

Ca(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)

Checking the balance:

Atom/IonReactant sideProduct side
Ca11 ✓
H22 (in H₂) ✓
Cl22 (in CaCl₂) ✓

State symbols:

  • Ca(s) — calcium is a solid metal
  • HCl(aq) — hydrochloric acid is in aqueous solution
  • CaCl₂(aq) — calcium chloride dissolves in water
  • H₂(g) — hydrogen is produced as a gas (the bubbles observed)

Why 2HCl? Calcium forms Ca²⁺ ions, so 2 Cl⁻ ions are needed to balance the charge → 2HCl as reactant.

steps.label:
Reactants: Ca + HCl  |  Products: CaCl₂ + H₂
Ca forms: Ca²⁺ ions → needs 2 Cl⁻ → coefficient 2 in front of HCl
Write the balanced symbol equation with state symbols. (3 marks)

fields.label: Correct formulae for all species (reactants and products): _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Reactants: Ca (calcium metal) and HCl (hydrochloric acid). Products: CaCl₂ (calcium chloride) and H₂ (hydrogen gas).

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: When a metal reacts with an acid: metal + acid → salt + hydrogen. Calcium + HCl → calcium chloride (CaCl₂) + hydrogen (H₂). The salt is CaCl₂ because Ca²⁺ needs two Cl⁻ ions.

fields.label: Balanced equation (correct coefficients): _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Need 2HCl to provide the 2 Cl⁻ ions for CaCl₂. Check: Ca:1/1 ✓, H:2/2 ✓, Cl:2/2 ✓.

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: Ca + 2HCl → CaCl₂ + H₂. The coefficient 2 in front of HCl is essential: CaCl₂ has 2 chlorine atoms, so 2 HCl molecules are needed. This also balances the hydrogen (2H from 2HCl → H₂).

fields.label: Correct state symbols for all species: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Ca is solid (s); HCl is in aqueous solution (aq); CaCl₂ dissolves in water (aq); H₂ is gas evolved (g).

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: State symbols: Ca is a solid metal (s); HCl is dissolved in water — aqueous (aq); CaCl₂ is soluble in water (aq); H₂ is the gas that causes bubbling (g).
